## README.md
# Soft Commodity Infrastructure (Brazil)

![brazil](https://img.shields.io/badge/brazil-blue) ![soft commodities](https://img.shields.io/badge/soft_commodities-blue) ![supply chain](https://img.shields.io/badge/supply_chain-blue) ![traceability](https://img.shields.io/badge/traceability-blue) ![EUDR](https://img.shields.io/badge/EUDR-blue) ![deforestation](https://img.shields.io/badge/deforestation-blue) ![cooperatives](https://img.shields.io/badge/cooperatives-blue) ![slaughterhouses](https://img.shields.io/badge/slaughterhouses-blue) ![grain silos](https://img.shields.io/badge/grain_silos-blue) ![sugar ethanol](https://img.shields.io/badge/sugar_ethanol-blue) ![agriculture](https://img.shields.io/badge/agriculture-blue)

Where Brazilian farms connect to markets. This is the geolocated midstream of
Brazilian agriculture: the silos, slaughterhouses, dairy plants, and sugar/ethanol
mills that farms sell into, plus the cooperatives that farms belong to. It exists
to answer, for any rural property, **who to contact** about deforestation on the
land — the cooperative that has the farmer as a member, or the buyer that receives
their grain, cattle, or cane.

## How it was made

Every point comes from a government registry, or is geocoded from one. Nothing is
guessed from satellite imagery.

- **Grain silos** — CONAB's national warehouse registry (`ArmazensCadastrados`),
  which every grain warehouse must register with. It ships real GPS coordinates,
  so these are exact. Includes cooperative, trader/private, and official silos.
- **Slaughterhouses & dairy plants, federal** — MAPA's SIF (federal meat/dairy
  inspection) registry. Has the company, tax ID, and address but no coordinates,
  so we geocoded the addresses ourselves. Beef, poultry, pork, dairy.
- **Slaughterhouses & dairy plants, state/municipal** — the smaller local plants
  (SIE/SIM/CONSORCIO) that a frontier producer often delivers to, which the
  federal list misses. These live in MAPA's SISBI system, which has no bulk
  download; Trase pulled the SISBI records and geocoded them from the registry
  addresses, and we use that subset. Registry-derived, not AI-detected.
- **Sugar/ethanol mills** — ANP's ethanol producer list (company, tax ID, town,
  capacity). No street address, so each mill sits at its town's center.
- **Cooperative membership** — IBGE's Censo Agropecuário 2017, which counts how
  many farms in each município belong to a cooperative. A density signal, not a
  named cooperative — but it works even in remote frontier towns.
- **Municipality geometry** — IBGE's official município boundaries.

## Trust labels on every row

Because not every point is equally precise, each carries two labels. **`basis`**
is `observed` (someone official recorded it) or `modelled` (we calculated it — only
the gravity-catchment rows). **`geom_method`** is `registered` (the source gave us
the GPS coordinate — CONAB silos), `geocoded` (we turned an address into a point —
can be off), or `municipality_centroid` (all we had was the town). A user can see
at a glance how good each location is.

## Full methodology & source

Pipeline, tests, and a plain-language writeup live at
https://github.com/wri/rural-land (see `soft_commodity_infrastructure/METHODOLOGY.md`).
Brazil only. Rice, cotton, and coffee are not covered — no authoritative open
geolocated source exists for them.


## Collections

### [facilities](./facilities/)

Facility and membership layers for Brazilian soft-commodity supply chains. One
unified layer plus the components it's built from. Geometry is WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

- **`BR_facilities`**...

## Source

[https://github.com/wri/rural-land](https://github.com/wri/rural-land)

## Processing Notes

Facilities compiled from government registries. Grain silos: CONAB national warehouse registry (registered coordinates), cooperative + trader + official. Slaughterhouses & dairy plants: MAPA SIF (federal, address-geocoded) plus Trase SISBI (state/municipal, registry-geocoded). Sugar/ethanol mills: ANP producers, municipality-centroid. Cooperative membership: IBGE Censo Agropecuário 2017 by município. Every geometry carries a `basis` (observed | modelled) and `geom_method` (registered | geocoded | municipality_centroid) so precision is explicit. No AI-detected geometry. BR_facilities.parquet is the unified layer (all tiers); the other files are the component layers. See METHODOLOGY.md in the source repo for full detail.
